test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

The soldiers would not have surrendered if they __not ran out__ of ammunition.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Had not run out**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the underlined segment of the given sentence, the use of the **simple **past tense ''not ran out'' is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is the third conditional sentence explaining that present circumstances would be different if something different had happened in the past.
 
• The third conditional sentence format: past perfect, modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.)​ + have + past participle.
 
• When using the third conditional, we use the past perfect i.e. had + past participle (here, run) in the if-clause and the modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.) + have + past participle (here, surrendered) in the main clause.
 
• Therefore, the past perfect **''**had not run out**''** should be used in place of the simple past tense ''not ran out''.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *The soldiers would not have surrendered if they **had not run out** of ammunition*.
